tei:div.tei:p: (57) kyai/ phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na// nyi ma byang shar pha ki na// rin chen brag ri'i gtams pa yi// sman spos skyed tshal rgyas pa nas// phyi ltar yul skyong dgra lha che// btsan rgod rdo rjed gra 'joms rtsal// nang ltar gnod sbyi yang le ber// btsan rgod ya ba rkya bdun tshogs// gsang ba padma he ru ka /dbang chen rta mchog rol pa che// bkra shis char chen 'bebs pa'i phyir// spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// kyai// gnam sngon zhun du bzhus pa ni// sa la 'khyil 'dra'i mthing gi mtsho// dgos 'byung nor bu'i mdzod khang nas/ phyi ltar wa ru ṇa yi lcam// stong khams klu yi tshogs dang bcas// nang ltar sman btsun tshe ring ma// mched lnga sman mo 'bum dang bcas/ gsang ba rnal 'byor ral gcig ma// srid pa ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas/ bkra shis char chen 'bebs pa'i phyir// spyan 'dren dgyes pa'i mchod tshogs sprin// thugs la gang bzhed 'char ba yi// nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor los mchod// glog ltar g.yo ba'i rdzu 'phrul mthus// chu (58)'dzin nor bu'i lhun po nas// glog dmar g.yo ba'i ska rags can// yid 'ong 'brug gi sgra dang bcas// bdud rtsi'i char chen mdzad med rgyun// skad cig myur ba nyid du phob// slob dpon padma thod phreng sogs// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i tha tshig la/ dgongs te skad cig da lta 'dir/ ma g.yel thogs med char chen phob// dge'o//
